claim.summary: src/click/types.py defines ParamType (generic ABC: convert/fail/get_metavar/shell_complete/to_info_dict/split_envvar_value) and concrete types: FuncParamType, UNPROCESSED, STRING, Choice, DateTime, INT/IntRange, FLOAT/FloatRange, BOOL, UUID, File, Path, Tuple (composite). convert_type maps Python types/defaults/ParamType instances to ParamType singletons. Singletons are module-level t.Final instances at the end of the file. Failures go through ParamType.fail -> BadParameter.

interfaces.name: ParamType
interfaces.behavior: Generic ABC (line 65), class attrs is_composite=False, arity=1, name (must be set by subclass), envvar_list_splitter=None (whitespace). __call__ returns None for None, else self.convert(value,param,ctx). Base convert returns value unchanged. get_metavar and get_missing_message return None by default; shell_complete returns []. split_envvar_value does (rv or '').split(envvar_list_splitter). On Python<3.13 __class_getitem__ fills the 2nd type param with Any.
edge_cases: to_info_dict derives param_type from class name stripped of 'ParamType'/'ParameterType' suffix; falls back to that when subclass has no `name`
convert must tolerate param=None and ctx=None (prompts)
split_envvar_value on None-like falsy rv gives [] when splitter is None, [''] otherwise

interfaces.name: ParamType.to_info_dict
interfaces.behavior: Returns {'param_type': str, 'name': str}; subclasses extend with **super().to_info_dict().
edge_cases: missing name attr uses derived class name

interfaces.name: ParamType.fail
interfaces.behavior: Raises BadParameter(message, ctx=ctx, param=param); typed NoReturn.
edge_cases: param and ctx optional

interfaces.name: ParamType.convert
interfaces.behavior: Override point; identity by default (line 179).
edge_cases: not called for None

interfaces.name: ParamType.shell_complete
interfaces.behavior: Returns list of CompletionItem; default empty list.

interfaces.name: CompositeParamType
interfaces.behavior: ParamType subclass with is_composite=True and abstract arity property; base for Tuple.

interfaces.name: FuncParamType
interfaces.behavior: Wraps a callable; name=func.__name__. convert calls func(value); on ValueError fails with str(exc), or str(value) if message empty (bytes decoded utf-8 'replace' on UnicodeError). to_info_dict adds 'func'.
edge_cases: only ValueError is caught; other exceptions propagate
empty ValueError message falls back to the value

interfaces.name: Choice
interfaces.behavior: Choice(choices, case_sensitive=True); choices stored as tuple (iterable consumed once). convert normalizes value via normalize_choice, builds {original: normalized} mapping each call, returns first original whose normalized equals. Enum members normalize to .name, others to str(). normalize_choice applies ctx.token_normalize_func then casefold if not case_sensitive. get_metavar: for options with show_choices False uses upper-cased type names of choices; else 'a|b|c'; wrapped in {} for required argument, [] otherwise. shell_complete prefix matches normalized choices.
edge_cases: value not in choices -> fail with get_invalid_choice_message (ngettext singular 'X is not Y.' when 1 choice)
non-str values (ints, enums) are compared via normalized str
duplicate normalized values: first match wins (no check despite docstring)
ctx may be None

interfaces.name: Choice.normalize_choice
interfaces.behavior: (choice, ctx)->str normalization hook; overridable (versionadded 8.2).
edge_cases: Enum uses .name

interfaces.name: Choice.get_invalid_choice_message
interfaces.behavior: Returns "'d' is not one of 'a', 'b', 'c'." using repr of normalized values; singular form for single choice.
edge_cases: value repr uses raw value

interfaces.name: DateTime
interfaces.behavior: DateTime(formats=None); default formats '%Y-%m-%d','%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S','%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' (used when formats falsy). convert returns datetime instances as-is, else tries strptime for each format in order.
edge_cases: empty formats list falls back to defaults
non-string non-datetime value: strptime raises TypeError (only ValueError caught)
metavar '[fmt1|fmt2]'

interfaces.name: IntRange
interfaces.behavior: IntRange(min=None,max=None,min_open=False,max_open=False,clamp=False); converts via int() then range-checks. With clamp, out-of-range returns bound (bound±1 if open).
edge_cases: clamp checks min before max
failure message '{value} is not in the range {range}.' e.g. '0<=x<=10'
non-int string -> '... is not a valid integer.'

interfaces.name: FloatRange
interfaces.behavior: Like IntRange over float(); __init__ raises TypeError if clamp with min_open/max_open; _clamp on open bound raises RuntimeError.
edge_cases: clamp with open bounds rejected at construction

interfaces.name: BoolParamType
interfaces.behavior: BOOL singleton. convert uses str_to_bool: bools pass through, strings stripped/lowercased and looked up in class dict bool_states (1/0/yes/no/true/false/on/off/t/f/y/n/'' ).
edge_cases: empty string -> False
non-str non-bool value raises AttributeError on .strip
unknown -> failure listing sorted recognized states

interfaces.name: BoolParamType.str_to_bool
interfaces.behavior: Static; returns bool or None if unknown.

interfaces.name: StringParamType
interfaces.behavior: STRING; bytes decoded with argv encoding, then filesystem encoding, then utf-8 replace; anything else str(value).
edge_cases: never fails

interfaces.name: UnprocessedParamType
interfaces.behavior: UNPROCESSED; returns value unchanged, name 'text'.

interfaces.name: UUIDParameterType
interfaces.behavior: UUID singleton; returns uuid.UUID as-is, else strips string and uuid.UUID(value).
edge_cases: only ValueError caught

interfaces.name: File
interfaces.behavior: File(mode='r',encoding=None,errors='strict',lazy=None,atomic=False); name 'filename'; envvar splitter os.path.pathsep. convert returns file-like objects (has read or write) unchanged. resolve_lazy_flag: explicit lazy wins; '-' -> not lazy; 'w' in mode -> lazy; else not lazy. Lazy uses _LazyFile registered with ctx.call_on_close(close_intelligently); otherwise open_stream and ctx.call_on_close closes (or flushes for std streams).
edge_cases: ctx None: caller must close
OSError -> '<filename>': strerror
to_info_dict only mode and encoding

interfaces.name: Path
interfaces.behavior: Path(exists=False,file_okay=True,dir_okay=True,writable=False,readable=True,resolve_path=False,allow_dash=False,path_type=None,executable=False). Generic over converted type. name is 'file'/'directory'/'path' by flags. convert: skip checks for allowed dash; realpath if resolve_path; os.stat; missing -> returns value if not exists else fail; then file/dir check, readable, writable, executable checks; result via coerce_path_result.
edge_cases: nonexistent path with exists=False skips all further checks
executable check uses original value not resolved rv
bytes dash handled
path_type str/bytes use fsdecode/fsencode, else path_type(value)
to_info_dict omits executable, resolve_path

interfaces.name: Path.coerce_path_result
interfaces.behavior: Converts to self.type if not already instance.
edge_cases: None keeps value

interfaces.name: Tuple
interfaces.behavior: Tuple(types) composite; each element passed through convert_type; name '<int text>'; arity=len(types). convert checks len(value) equals arity then converts each element.
edge_cases: length mismatch fail with ngettext message
len(value) on non-sized raises TypeError

interfaces.name: convert_type
interfaces.behavior: convert_type(ty=None, default=None): _guess_type first (default type / first item of list/tuple default; nested sequences become tuple of types), then tuple->Tuple, ParamType instance as is, str/None->STRING, int->INT, float->FLOAT, bool->BOOL; guessed-but-unknown types -> STRING; otherwise FuncParamType(ty).
edge_cases: ParamType subclass (uninstantiated) raises AssertionError under __debug__
empty list default -> STRING
explicit non-recognized class e.g. pathlib.Path becomes FuncParamType

claim.error_conventions: Validation failures call ParamType.fail which raises click.exceptions.BadParameter(message, ctx, param). Messages are gettext-wrapped (_ / ngettext), use {value!r} reprs, end with a period (e.g. "'d' is not one of 'a', 'b'."; "{value!r} is not a valid integer."; "{name} {filename!r} does not exist."). Programmer errors use TypeError (FloatRange open+clamp), RuntimeError (open float clamp), AssertionError (uninstantiated ParamType class in convert_type). Non-ValueError exceptions from conversion propagate.

examples.code:
choice = click.Choice(["a", "b", "c"])
message = choice.get_invalid_choice_message("d", ctx=None)
assert message == "'d' is not one of 'a', 'b', 'c'."

examples.description: Path with path_type in a command
examples.code:
cli = click.Command(
    "cli",
    params=[click.Argument(["p"], type=click.Path(path_type=cls))],
    callback=lambda p: p,
)
result = runner.invoke(cli, ["a/b/c.txt"], standalone_mode=False)

examples.description: Path error message includes escaped newline
examples.code:
with pytest.raises(click.BadParameter) as exc_info:
    click.Path(dir_okay=False).convert(tempdir, None, None)
assert "my\\ndir" in exc_info.value.message

tests.how_it_asserts: Parametrized with pytest.param(..., id=...) comparing to_info_dict() output dicts of each type (Choice, DateTime, IntRange, Path, Tuple, etc.) to expected dicts.
Single plain test calling get_invalid_choice_message directly with ctx=None and asserting the exact string.

Plain functions using pytest.raises(click.BadParameter), tmp_path/monkeypatch, runner.invoke on a Command with standalone_mode=False and checking result.return_value, parametrized path_type; also t.get_args(click.Path[pathlib.Path]).

extension_points.name: ParamType subclassing (convert/get_metavar/shell_complete/to_info_dict)
extension_points.what_could_attach: Custom types subclass ParamType, set name, override convert and call self.fail.

extension_points.name: Choice.normalize_choice
extension_points.what_could_attach: Override for custom normalization (aliases, prefix matching).

extension_points.name: Choice.get_invalid_choice_message
extension_points.what_could_attach: Override for custom error text, e.g. did-you-mean suggestions.

extension_points.name: BoolParamType.bool_states
extension_points.what_could_attach: Class-level dict mapping that could be extended or made configurable.

extension_points.name: _NumberRangeBase._clamp
extension_points.what_could_attach: Abstract hook for new numeric range types.

extension_points.name: convert_type
extension_points.what_could_attach: Dispatch chain on Python type; a place to register new type mappings (e.g. UUID, datetime, enum, Path).

gaps.description: No Enum-based type; Choice accepts enums but the dispatch in convert_type doesn't map enum classes to Choice
gaps.why_plausible: Choice already supports enum members via normalize_choice using .name

gaps.description: BOOL true/false strings are not user-configurable
gaps.why_plausible: The docstring on bool_states explicitly mentions future work for configurability

gaps.description: DateTime has no timezone-aware default formats or fromisoformat support
gaps.why_plausible: Docstring says defaults are non-timezone-aware; formats list is the only knob

gaps.description: Path lacks a check for file extension / suffix or max size
gaps.why_plausible: Path validations are a flat list of checks in convert; one more fits the pattern

gaps.description: Path.to_info_dict omits executable, resolve_path and path_type
gaps.why_plausible: Info dict is meant for documentation tools and other flags are included

gaps.description: Open float ranges cannot be clamped (RuntimeError); math.nextafter could implement it
gaps.why_plausible: Source comment mentions nextafter as an option

limitations: Choice rebuilds its normalized mapping on every convert and does not validate uniqueness of normalized values.
FuncParamType, UUID and DateTime catch only ValueError; other exceptions propagate (e.g. DateTime TypeError on non-str).
BoolParamType.convert raises AttributeError for non-str, non-bool input.
Tuple.convert relies on len(value); no nargs validation here.
Path executable check uses the unresolved value while other checks use the resolved path.
File's to_info_dict does not include lazy/atomic/errors.
Tests directly covering this module are sparse for Choice (one test); other types are covered in sibling test files in tests/test_types/.
